abstract: Despite recent advances in the systemic chemotherapy of patients with malignant trophoblastic disease, there remains a small group of patients who fail to achieve remission with this type of treatment. The present study presents 19 patients with malignant trophoblastic disease who underwent a total of 25 arteriographic studies for localization of persistent malignant lesions and 8 patients who underwent arterial infusional chemotherapy after they had failed to achieve remission by standard administration of systemic methotrexate or actinomycin D. Patients underwent pelvic, pulmonary, carotid, and multiple abdominal selective arteriograms with a high correlation of positive findings and the later documented presence of persistent malignant disease. Findings include prominent uterine arteries, arteriovenous shunts, hypervascularity, irregular vessels, and tumor staining within the tumor. Arterially infused chemotherapy with methotrexate or actinomycin D was used in 8 patients whose disease was resistant to systemic chemotherapy. Technics of arterial infusion are discussed.
abstract_ja: 近年の全身化学療法の進歩にもかかわらず、悪性絨毛性疾患の患者には寛解が得られない少数例が残る。本研究では、持続性の悪性病変の局在診断を目的として動脈造影を受けた悪性絨毛性疾患患者19例(計25回の動脈造影)と、標準的な全身性メトトレキサートまたはアクチノマイシンDの投与で寛解が得られなかった患者8例を対象とした。骨盤、肺、頸動脈、複数の腹部選択的動脈造影を行った。陽性所見(子宮動脈の拡張、動静脈シャント、過血管性、不整な血管、腫瘍内の染色)と、後に確認された持続性悪性疾患との間に高い相関が認められた。全身化学療法に抵抗性であった8例には、メトトレキサートまたはアクチノマイシンDによる動注化学療法を施行した。動脈注入の手技について考察する。
